title: Three Years and One Short Lamp
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：piece　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 piece 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the grandmother ① cut the piece that no child in the courtyard would have counted, and he said the cutting was the whole of the year. The ② piece, meaning the part itself and not the lamp, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a piece, he said, is the only thing in a courtyard that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ piece in that courtyard had the same short lamp beside it, and the ④ piece at the far window, meaning the gift they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A piece, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the grandmother said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the piece was the whole of the matter, meaning the share and not the part. The ⑥ piece, meaning the share and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; piece, he said, is either something you cut or the only word that means both a part and a share. He said the share is the part they remember.

By 1995 the ⑦ piece had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short lamp. The ⑧ piece of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in February, was one courtyard and three years of counting; piece, he said, is either the gift at the far window or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ piece I remember is the part counted in the diary, which closed in 1997 and is still counted as the quietest in the courtyard. A ⑩ piece, my mother said in 1999, is the only part that improves by being counted; every piece, she said, is a share that has agreed to look like a part. She said the share was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 一块；一件（指院子里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 一块；一件（指那块一块本身，与小小的灯相对）
C. 固定搭配：cut the piece 切这一块一块
D. n. 一块；一件（指留给孩子们守着的那一件）
E. n. 一块之事（抽象总称，指一处院子的一块之事）
F. n. 一块；一件（指日记里写到、被清点的那一块）
G. n. 一块、份儿（指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 份儿（抽象总称，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: cut the piece that no child in the courtyard would have counted
The piece, meaning the part itself and not the lamp
the piece at the far window
the piece was the whole of the matter
the piece had become a line in a diary
The piece of the whole thing
A piece, my mother said in 1999

answers.why: cut the piece 意为“切这一块一块”，1990 年那位祖母把院子里没有一位孩子肯清点的一块一块做了一遍。
piece 意为“一块；一件”，指那块一块本身而不是小小的灯，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。
piece 意为“一块；一件”，指院子里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一盏小小的灯。
piece 意为“一块；一件”，指最远那扇窗边的留给孩子们守着的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
piece 意为“一块、份儿”，指一件事里人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这块份儿就是那件事的全部。
piece 意为“份儿”，指人人都惦却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块一块，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
piece 意为“一块；一件”，指日记里写到、被清点的那一块，到 1995 年这一块成了日记里的一行。
piece 意为“一块之事”，祖母二月写道，整件事的一块之事是一处院子和三个年头的清点。
piece 意为“一块；一件”，我记得的是日记里清点过的那一块，1997 年过完了，至今仍被说成院子里最安静的一块。
piece 为抽象总称，母亲 1999 年说，一块是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的一块。
